title: Repeated research exposure removes untouched-day status
evidence: The same MSFT session informed features, model phases and execution diagnostics. Five chronological test folds do not undo researcher exposure.
why_it_matters: Human adaptation and uncounted cross-phase choices can inflate apparent evidence.
core_results_change: No numerical change; weakens signal certainty.
required_fix: Evaluate frozen decisions on genuinely new days in a separately authorized project.

title: One historical stock-day cannot establish external validity
evidence: Only MSFT 2003-01-03, legacy Island/INET-lineage event semantics and venue-specific displayed book.
why_it_matters: No independent days, stock population, modern market, live execution or institutional capacity are tested.
required_fix: Restrict every conclusion to this sample; new data are outside Phase 7.

title: Transport completeness and legal tick remain unverified
evidence: Archive has millisecond timestamps and physical row ordering but no original transport sequence numbers. Tick columns are null and excluded.
why_it_matters: A consistently reconstructable archive can still omit messages; encoding precision is not proof of legal tick size.
core_results_change: No discrepancy detected; completeness cannot be certified.
required_fix: Retain explicit source limitations; do not impute tick features.

title: Uncertainty is conditional on one dependent observed path
evidence: Clock bootstrap and circular shifts rely on approximate temporal regularity. Shifts introduce artificial seams; frozen-path PnL blocks do not regenerate inventory decisions.
why_it_matters: Intervals exclude new-day, researcher-selection, model-fitting and execution-model uncertainty.
core_results_change: No formula correction; conditional estimates reproduce.
required_fix: Describe conditional intervals and approximate nulls, never independent-trade or population confidence.

title: Fixed normalization is not a funded account return
evidence: 53.60 is the first valid session midpoint; inventory stays within one share but continued trading after losses can require borrowing.
why_it_matters: No margin, financing, stock-borrow or insolvency engine supports the percentage-return interpretation.
core_results_change: Absolute PnL and PnL/notional are unchanged.
required_fix: Use dollars and traded-notional bps as primary economic evidence; label normalization a denominator convention.

title: Displayed-quote simulation omits operational execution frictions
evidence: One-share price-taking model, no impact, hidden liquidity modeling, broker/transport delays, actual historical fee/rebate schedule or passive queue model.
why_it_matters: Displayed depth and an as-of state do not guarantee historical fills; fee stresses are hypothetical.
core_results_change: Loss under the stated assumptions reproduces; no capacity or live claim.
required_fix: Keep aggressive simulation conditional; no passive switch or profitability search.

title: README current-status wording is historical
evidence: README says Phase 1 only and later stop after Phase 3, while frozen Phase 4–6 artifacts exist.
why_it_matters: Readers can misread archival scope as current repository status.
required_fix: Publish an explicit current-status correction without changing frozen historical reports.
